name: Confluence Cloud
description: Confluence Cloud wiki (14 tools): CQL search, CRUD for pages and blogposts, readable Live Docs, comments, labels, spaces. Safe updates via expected_version. Shares Atlassian credentials with Jira.

credentials_required.label: Atlassian Email
credentials_required.hint: Your Atlassian account email (same across Jira + Confluence).

credentials_required.label: Atlassian API Token
credentials_required.hint: Create at id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. NOTE: Atlassian enforces token expiry (1-365 days) — you will need to rotate it manually.

credentials_required.label: Atlassian Site URL
credentials_required.hint: Your site subdomain, e.g. 'your-org.atlassian.net' (without https:// prefix).

tools.name: list_spaces
tools.description: List all Confluence spaces (id, key, name, type)

tools.name: list_pages_in_space
tools.description: List pages and blogposts in a space. Parameters: space_id (required, numeric id from list_spaces), limit (optional), content_type (optional: page or blogpost to narrow).

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Search Confluence with CQL or plain text. Pages and blogposts are both searched by default; narrow with content_type. Plain text is auto-wrapped, real CQL (containing = or ~) is passed through unchanged. Parameters: query (required), limit (optional), content_type (optional).

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Fetch a page or blogpost by id, with body, version and space. Blogposts are detected automatically. Live Docs are returned as readable text. The Version number shown can be passed to update_page as expected_version for a safe edit. Parameters: page_id (required), content_type (optional: page or blogpost).

tools.name: get_page_by_title
tools.description: Find a page or blogpost by exact title. Searches pages first, then blogposts. Parameters: title (required), space_id (optional), content_type (optional).

tools.name: list_children
tools.description: List child pages of a page. Blogposts have no children and are reported as such. Parameters: page_id (required), limit (optional).

tools.name: create_page
tools.description:
Create a new page or blogpost. Body MUST be storage-format HTML, e.g. '

Hello

Section

'. Set content_type to blogpost to create a blog entry. Parameters: space_id (required), title (required), body (required), parent_id (optional, pages only), content_type (optional).

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Update title and/or body of a page or blogpost. Body must be storage-format HTML. The version is bumped automatically. Best practice: call get_page first and pass its Version as expected_version - the update is then refused instead of silently overwriting someone else's edit. Content that exists only in ADF format (no storage representation) is refused rather than wiped. Sending only a title keeps the existing body. Parameters: page_id (required), title (optional), body (optional), expected_version (optional), change_note (optional), content_type (optional).

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete a page or blogpost by id (moves it to the trash). Blogposts are detected automatically. Parameters: page_id (required), content_type (optional).

tools.name: add_comment_to_page
tools.description: Add a comment to a page or blogpost. Works on Live Docs too. Parameters: page_id (required), text (required).

tools.name: list_comments_on_page
tools.description: List comments on a page or blogpost. Parameters: page_id (required).

tools.name: add_label_to_page
tools.description: Add a label to a page (for categorization and label-based search)

tools.name: list_labels_on_page
tools.description: List labels on a page or blogpost. Parameters: page_id (required).

tools.name: search_by_label
tools.description: Find content carrying a label. Returns pages and blogposts. Parameters: label (required), limit (optional), content_type (optional).

author: freddy-schuetz
